asked: # Fix a failing AXF Dev Console systems check: Console public URL set The console's systems check reported this, and its automatic fix failed. Fix the cause, then re-check. - Check id: `routine:env-public-url` (service console, status warn) - What it says: AXF_PUBLIC_URL isn't set - How the fix failed: You don't have to do it by hand. Run both from an axHub-connected Mosses session (the console's Mosses chat, which has `axhub_call`) and they'll come to you as two approvals. Details: - Alerts and push notifications use it to link back to the console, so links come out empty without it. - env {"name": "AXF_PUBLIC_URL"} How it's fixed by hand: - Set AXF_PUBLIC_URL=https://console.amberxai.com in the console's Coolify environment. - Redeploy the console. Rules: - Fix only this check. Change nothing unrelated; never delete data, volumes, containers or other people's files. - Never print, copy or commit secrets (tokens, keys, .env files, .axf-console/). - Code changes go on this worktree's branch only: commit and push the branch, never main, never merge. - When done, refresh the host report: `bash /opt/axf/deploy/console-doctor.sh --report`. - Record steps and the result on your change-log entry (the hooks do most of it; `changes.mjs step|result last …`). - You may run shell commands on the VPS (you run as root): prefer the smallest, reversible change.

steps.text: install-console.sh: pass AXHUB_PROJECTS_DIR=/projects with the volume
installer passes AXF_PUBLIC_URL to the console container

result.summary: AXF_PUBLIC_URL now set on the live console (redeployed with patched install-console.sh); installer fix committed d29f2169 on fix/syscheck-routine-env-public-url but push failed: no valid GitHub credentials on the VPS (gh login and saved GITHUB_TOKEN rejected). Until merged, a main-triggered auto-update drops the var again.
